method: Use olefile0.47 HWP5 PrvText plus raw-deflate BodyText/Section0. Read printed distribution date/time, period, unit, working-day caveat and provisional revision warning. Locate semiconductor export row label followed by one amount and YoY in the same compressed table region, searching both UTF-16LE byte alignments. Report all candidate token offsets and ambiguity; do not select by desired economic sign or any SOXX outcome.
control_gate: The identical parser must recover 2021 official amount6,394/+23.9 and 2022 official amount5,573/-12.8 at prior recorded offsets. If not, stop before unknown-year interpretation.
stop: Any HWP parse, row/unit or year identity ambiguity remains unknown. No factor/model/account; five October releases are not a full monthly panel nor proof of exact first-public bytes.
